# [TASK] Implement Serverless Wakeup Endpoint and Frontend BackendStandbyModal Countdown UX

## Task
Implement Vercel serverless wake-up endpoint and frontend standby countdown modal with real-time health-checking, step progression, and Redux cache refresh.

## Parent Story
Parent: #156

## Scope
- `frontend/filmpire/api/wakeup.js` and `vercel.json`
- `frontend/filmpire/src/utils/apiUrl.js`
- `frontend/filmpire/src/components/BackendStandby/BackendStandbyModal.jsx` and hook
- Component tests and ESLint verification

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Serverless `/api/wakeup` responds to GET/POST and enforces cooldown.
- [x] `apiUrl.js` provides reactive health-checking and status subscription.
- [x] `BackendStandbyModal` displays circular ~90s countdown, multi-step progress, and cloud toggle.
- [x] Auto-dismisses and refreshes RTK Query on backend readiness.
- [x] All frontend unit tests and lint pass cleanly.

## Estimate
**Hours:** 4
